d: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) have revived their political alliance after a six-year split. Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced the reunion at a joint press conference in New Delhi, attended by BJP chief Nitin Nabin and SAD president Sukhbir Singh Badal. The two parties will contest the 2027 Punjab Assembly elections together. Their alliance ended in September 2020 after the Akali Dal withdrew from the NDA over the Centre's farm laws. The reunion marks a major political development ahead of the Punjab polls.
